savedCitation.unavailable: The source changed or cannot be located precisely. The saved quotation is retained below.

answerSave.unknown: The original question, excerpt and sources will be retained; source count is not yet confirmed.
answerSave.summary: Retain the original question, answer excerpt and {{count}} citations.

update.autoDownloadHelp: Download and prepare new versions in the background, then restart when you choose. Turn off to download manually.
update.confirmRestartDetail: Updating restarts the app and interrupts running tasks in all projects. After restarting, click Continue or send a new message to pick up where you left off. Existing results will be checked before continuing to avoid duplicate actions. We recommend waiting until tasks finish before updating.
update.confirmRestartFailed: Could not start the update. Please try again later.
update.confirmRestartChanged: The update state has changed. Cancel this confirmation and check for updates again.
update.downloadingSub: Downloading {{version}}. You can leave this page; ScholarSeed asks you to restart when it finishes.
update.readySub: {{version}} is downloaded. Restart to apply it.
update.failedRetained: The partial download is kept; the retry resumes where it stopped.
update.failedDiscarded: The partial download could not be kept; the retry starts over.
update.manualHint: Drag ScholarSeed into Applications to finish.
update.rolledBack: Update did not complete; restored the previous version
update.unsupported: Development builds do not check for updates (local lane)
update.idle: Not checked yet. ScholarSeed checks silently after startup.
update.insufficientSpace: There is not enough free disk space to continue the update. Free up disk space and try again. You can close this message to return to the app.
update.installDescription: The app will quit and finish updating in the background, then relaunch automatically. Please wait.
update.installVerifyUnavailable: ScholarSeed couldn't verify the update on this device. Download the latest version from the official website and install it manually.
update.installSignatureUntrusted: The update package failed signature verification and was blocked for your safety. Get the installer again from the official channel.
update.installSignatureIndeterminate: This device could not determine whether the update package signature is trusted (certificate chain or revocation information unavailable), so automatic installation was blocked. The signer matches the official release and the package bytes are intact, so re-downloading will not change this result. Restore network or root-certificate access and retry the install, or contact your network administrator.
update.installAlreadyRunning: The installer from the previous update attempt is still running. Wait for it to finish or close its window, then retry; the package is already staged, so no re-download is needed.
update.installInUse: Another Windows sign-in session is using ScholarSeed from this installation. Ask that user to exit ScholarSeed normally, then retry installation. The package is ready; no download is needed.
update.installOccupancyUnknown: We could not confirm whether another Windows sign-in session is using this installation. Installation is paused to protect running apps. Ask users in other sessions to exit ScholarSeed normally, then retry. If this continues, send feedback. The package is retained; no download is needed.
update.installRetryHint: The installer is still staged. Retrying reruns the installation only; it does not download again.
update.summaryHint: Here’s what’s new in this version.
update.stepIdentity: Checking the app version and compatibility…
update.stepStagingCleanup: Removing files from the previous preparation…
update.backgroundPreparing: Preparing the update in the background. Keep working and restart when it is ready.
update.preparingDescription: Preparing the update. The app is still open. Security checks and copying may take a few minutes. It will quit and restart automatically when preparation finishes.
update.cancellingDescription: Stopping the current step and cleaning up the disk image. You can retry once cleanup finishes. The current app will stay open.
update.cleanupDescription: Cleaning up the disk image. The installation result will appear when cleanup finishes.
update.installLimit: Step timeout limit: {{limit}}. This is not the time remaining.
update.waitingForLatest: Preparing the latest version. You can cancel the restart while preparation continues in the background.
update.installNotarizationIndeterminate: Local verification of the update’s notarization ticket could not complete, so the update did not continue. Retry later. This does not establish that the signature is invalid.

preview.currentLine: Fixes in the current release line
preview.currentVersion: New builds of this version only
preview.scopeHelp: Release-line updates include fixes such as 0.2.0 → 0.2.1. Pinning a version accepts only newer builds of the same version. Automatic downloading is controlled separately.
preview.switchHelp: Only approved Preview release lines compatible with this system are listed. Review the notes and confirm to start downloading.
preview.noLines: No release lines are available for upgrade. Updates within your current scope remain available.
preview.noNotes: No release notes are available for this version.
preview.confirmHelp: This upgrade uses only the selected build and does not follow other release lines. Restart still requires confirmation after downloading. Upgrading may migrate application data that older versions cannot read.
preview.failed: The operation did not complete. Check your connection and retry. The target release or upgrade permission may have changed.
preview.targetUnavailable: The selected release was withdrawn or the upgrade path was closed. Cancel this upgrade and choose again.
preview.reset: Reset to current release line (cancel cross-line selection)

landing.waitingBody: Complete login or registration in your browser. You will be returned to ScholarSeed automatically.
landing.elevatedHint: ScholarSeed is running with administrator privileges, so the browser login callback may not be delivered. If you stay on this page for a long time, restart ScholarSeed without administrator rights and try again.
landing.title: Easy research, start now.
landing.verifyError: The backend could not verify these login credentials. Check the account service address and backend configuration, then try again.
landing.browserError: Unable to open the system browser

runtimePreparation.failed: Runtime preparation did not complete. Your message has not been submitted. Check the model connection and send again; failed or unknown-outcome messages are never resent automatically.

runtimeSwitch.pending: Waiting for tasks and approvals to finish before switching the shared runtime automatically.
runtimeSwitch.previous: Waiting for the previous model's background switch; existing tasks will not be interrupted.
runtimeSwitch.applied: The runtime switched automatically. Manually resend any message that was not submitted.
runtimeSwitch.busy: The runtime is busy. Existing tasks were not interrupted. Retry the original action after tasks and approvals finish.
runtimeSwitch.stale: The selected model changed, so this background switch was not applied. Retry the original action for the current model.
runtimeSwitch.failed: The background switch did not complete. Check the model connection and retry the original action.
runtimeSwitch.unsupported: This runtime does not support automatic switching. Fully quit and restart the app.
runtimeSwitch.unknown: Reconciling the background switch. The switch and your message will not be resubmitted.
runtimeSwitch.restartRequired: A safe runtime switch could not be confirmed. New tasks are paused. Wait for existing operations to finish, then fully quit and restart the app.
